name: AssistantMessage
description:
An answer: no bubble — the AI mark in the gutter and the blocks on the canvas (or the
panel), prose across the reading column and wide blocks breaking out wider. Failure, cancellation
and retention show in place as the message's last block. Copy, regenerate, feedback and
"Open in window" sit below with the time and model; a host with no backend for feedback or
windows turns those off (`feedback`, `openInWindow`).

props.name: activity
props.description: What the model is doing right now (before or between blocks) while it streams.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Show the good and bad response buttons. Turn off when the host has nowhere to send feedback.

props.name: latest
props.description: The newest answer: its actions stay visible.

props.name: message
props.description: The typed conversation message and its content blocks.

props.name: openInWindow
props.description: Show "Open in a window". Turn off when the host has no window to open the answer in.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
